title: Today In Golf
summary: A 30-second briefing on today's biggest golf stories.

items.headline: DeChambeau’s Open Conduct Criticized
items.text: Bryson DeChambeau received harsh criticism for a two-shot penalty at The Open after improving his lie, delaying tee times, arguing for hours, and threatening to withdraw, drawing condemnation from Johnson Wagner and US Ryder Cup analytics lead Justin Ray.

items.headline: Rory McIlroy Plans Reduced Schedule
items.text: Rory McIlroy announced he will scale back his PGA Tour schedule, citing less importance in regular events as long as he remains in the top 30 before the Tour Championship.
